stories.summary: Own the public GET /sign-in and GET /auth/callback entry points, exempt from BSB-18-PENDING-3's per-request middleware: GET /sign-in is a rendered HTTP 200 page (including its ?error= render) with a Sign in control that starts Cognito's authorization-code flow, and the callback requires the verified token's sub and email claims, calls BSB-18-PENDING-2's create-or-reuse users upsert before setting the sb_session cookie, refuses a missing-sub token with sign_in_incomplete and no session or row, establishes the server-side sb_session contract consumed by PENDING-2 and PENDING-3 (distinguishing an anonymous request from an expired, unrefreshable session that PENDING-3 reports as session_expired), lands the member on the minimal /builds page and the empty GET /api/builds list, and owns the three-value /sign-in error contract (sign_in_incomplete, session_required, session_expired) and its exact messages that PENDING-3's denials use, refusing non-members, incorrect passwords and unverifiable callbacks without a session or users row

Supply the create-or-reuse users upsert and missing-sub refusal that BSB-18-PENDING-1's /auth/callback invokes before issuing the sb_session cookie, keeping exactly one builder account per Cognito subject in the builder's own users table (cognito_sub UNIQUE), created and reused on every successful sign-in by a current skill-builders member and shown on the middleware-protected /account page as the token email plus users.id, while the deployed image, its runtime and its startup carry no platform database client, connection or credential and refuse to start if one is configured

Own the single per-request authorization middleware for protected authoring pages and APIs — including /builds, GET /api/builds and BSB-18-PENDING-2's /account — with GET /sign-in (including its ?error= render) and GET /auth/callback named as public exemptions owned by BSB-18-PENDING-1, refusing anonymous and expired-session requests before any builder data is returned, using session_required only for a request with no session and session_expired only for an existing session whose ID token expired and whose refresh failed, sending pages to BSB-18-PENDING-1's shared error codes and messages and APIs a JSON 401, and re-reading the cognito:groups claim on every request so a member removed from the skill-builders group is denied within one hour with a 403 and no builder data
